page.overview:
Who is Ela Lumas?

Ginang () is the head of House Lumas, a Mahaan house in Jrusar. As an NPC, is played by Matthew Mercer.

Ela Lumas is a human woman in her late 50s to early 60s with russet skin. She is described as having "a calm beauty and a silent strength" and as carrying herself with weight. Each time the soon-to-be-named Bells Hells spoke with her at the Lumas estate, she was wearing a white dress and veil in mourning in a style indicating her wealth and station.

A kind but sorrowful woman, at the time of her encounter(s) with Bells Hells, Ela Lumas was still mourning the recent deaths of her twin children: Balan and Zeyar.

Ela Lumas is the head of House Lumas, a Mahaan house living the in Lucent Spire of Jrusar. As matriarch of the house, she is titled as "Ginang". She is the member of the family who largely deals with the Chandei Quorum and the other Mahaan houses, and she kept her twin children, Balan and Zeyar, away from complicated politics.
